unresolved_implication: The bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis has not been shown to force a scalar pivot plus a disjoint partition with both universal two-volume currency and leverage<1. The high-leverage complementary branch must retain the heavy physical row, complementary Pluecker mass and arbitrary same-side curvature jointly.
